nom: Peter Thomas Roth FIRMx Exfoliating Peeling Gel

segments.oily: One reviewer in her late 30s with oily skin reports the product leaves skin looking plump and smooth.
segments.dry: Many reviewers with dry skin (including desert-climate and winter-dry cases) report it removes flaking and rough patches without over-drying, though one dry-skin reviewer felt it did nothing.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it clears flaky dead skin that used to lift makeup and leaves skin smooth, with one noting she limits use to every two weeks to avoid over-drying.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers, including some with eczema or rosacea, report no irritation and good tolerance, but one sensitive-skin user had a severe burning reaction requiring medical treatment.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s report smoother skin, fewer visible pores, and compliments on their skin after regular use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for aging skin report smaller-looking pores, more even tone, and one describes dramatic tone change with weekly use; another with age spots and sun damage reports pores less deep and tone improved.
concerns.dehydration: Numerous reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report flakes and dry patches removed and improved moisturizer absorption without added dryness; one dry-skin reviewer reports no noticeable effect at all.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea reports it does not irritate or redden skin, unlike a harsher peeling gel she tried previously; another notes her face does not get red after use, unlike other exfoliators.
concerns.barrier: One long-term user with acne-prone, texture-affected skin reports no stinging and no disruption to her skin barrier despite frequent use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports lightening of melasma and another reports age spots and uneven tone improving with weekly use.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with mild blemishes reports noticeably improved texture; another reports a forehead pimple appeared reduced and skin brightened after one use; a third reports some breakouts after first use that did not continue.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer describes her skin as combination but prone to excess oiliness in reaction to certain products, and reports this product cleared problem areas and reduced tiny bumps under the skin.

aspects.libelle: Debated whether pilling is dead skin or product
Skin feels smooth and soft after use
High price relative to similar products

extraits.texte: I received this as a free sample from Ulta. I did a spot test as i do with any new product and it was fine. I used this on my face one time and read the directions first. I have been an avid skincare user for nearly 10 years. After rinsing this product from my face, two hours later my face started to burn. Like burn, burn. I rinsed my face with water and I had like burn/welts on my face. Basically this product un-did all of the care I had been taking of my face. I immediately stopped using the product but I also could not use any other product or wear makeup for about 2 days. I ended up having to go to the doctor for some cream to heal the burns and contact dermatitis. Ulta gave me a gift card when i contacted customer service but Peter Thomas Roth was extremely difficult to get a hold of and played phone tag for over a week. Very traumatic experience. Do not use if you have sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: Best product that I have ever purchased
extraits.texte: I have KP and an uneven skin tone I also have very sensitive skin, which makes finding products difficult This exfoliating product has been a game changer. It just rolls off the dead skin. Within a week, 2 coworkers told me how good my skin looked! No joke. My moisturizer is soaking in better as well. Buy it, you won't regret it

I am so mad at myself every time I try to find another exfoliation skincare product, I see other skincare exfoliating products being raved about and I can't help myself but want to try it! Well it never has worked out well for me, almost every skincare product I try, I ALWAYS break out. My skin gets super irritated, I get tiny bumps everywhere. I don't know what it is but this is the only thing my skin can tolerate, it truly makes my skin look amazing. Every time I go back to this I want to smack myself for wasting money on anything else! If your reading this review just know everyone's skin is truly different. There's no telling if your skin will agree with any type of skincare product. I definitely recommend getting the mini version and trying it! As someone with extremely sensitive/acne prone this is truly a miracle for me!

extraits.titre: Review for dry, late 30s, desert climate skin
extraits.texte: I am white, late 30s, and live in the desert. Because I live in the dry desert my skin looks a lot more wrinkled, dry and aged as opposed to women who live in the mountains or ocean. My makeup application looks quite awful often due to dry skin so a skincare routine is of the utmost necessity. I still have not found a good moisturizer which means I am in need of an exfoliate for that crusty dry skin that always appears when foundation is applied. I have tried various exfoliates and what happens is that they make the skin more flaky but it just sits stuck to my face still in tact, looking worse. That includes scrubs, acids, masks, etc from DIY, drugstore to ULTA quality brands. I purchased a Thomas Roth trial kit with 5 products, and some were okay nor didn't work for me, but this exfoliate is my holy grail. I especially get flaky skin around my nostrils from having a runny nose from allergies, and I rub a dab of this around that area and the dead skin falls away so easily without disturbing any other areas of my face. This is definitely worth tracking down a sample size of to see if it works for you.

I've been using this for over 10 years and it's worked well for my combination, acne-prone skin with texture issues. The gel is easy to apply, pills as you rub it in, and my skin feels smooth afterward without any stinging. I use it about 2–3 times a week and it doesn't dry me out or mess with my skin barrier. The only downside is the peeling texture, which some people won't like, and it's probably not for you if you prefer chemical exfoliants. This is a solid exfoliator I keep coming back to because it does what it's supposed to without causing irritation.

Randomly decided to try this out and so glad I did. I have combo skin but I can also get excessively oily when I use certain products. This stuff literally got rid of problem areas that I hadn't gotten to go away in a long time. All the tiny bumps under my skin seemed to go away after a couple uses. I got a few breakouts after the first use(l think it just pushed all the yucky stuff out) but it didn't make me continue to breakout. My skin is sooo smooth and brighter looking. Definitely purchasing again once I'm out.

extraits.titre: The perfect cleanse to rid a muddy feeling face
extraits.texte: I had used Dr G peeling gel to exfoliate- but felt it was too harsh on my sensitive skin (I also have rosacea). It felt like it kept peeling even healthy skin. I tried this and will never go back! It exfoliates only dead skin, and leaves my face glowing and refreshed. My skin is no longer irritated, but rejuvenated. HIGHLY recommend
